ripe.description: True if the target strawberry is fully ripe (uniformly red).

bbox.description: Target strawberry bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in pixels, top-left origin, with x1 <= x2 and y1 <= y2.

picking_point.description: Grasp point on the peduncle (stem) just above the calyx, as [u, v] in pixels, top-left origin.
